fullContentHtml:
Railway RRB Section Controller Application Status 2026 - Complete Details

Short Details : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released Application Status for the recruitment of Section Controller on the official website of the RRBs. This recruitment was released for 119 posts. Applications for the Railway RRB Section Controller Recruitment 2026 were accepted from July 15, 2026, to August 14, 2026. The CBT-I examination is going to conducted on 12-13 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Railway RRB Section Controller Application Status 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 July 2026
  • Last Date : 14 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 16 August 2026
  • Form Corrections Last Date : 17-26 August 2026
  • Application Status : 16 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 12-13 October 2026
  • Exam City Details : 10 Days Before Exam
  • Admit Card : 04 Days Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Minorities / 3rd Gender : Rs. 250/-
  • After Appear the Stage I Exam
  • UR, OBC, EWS Fee Refund : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH, Female Refund : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
